answer: Because the timing is published against the delta challenge, the thread audit can replay the terrace history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 46 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Scaling to 784 identities multiplies that fee by 839 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
